'''''Bellboy''''' was a [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifter]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] used by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tormentor/Legends|Tormentor]]''.

==History==
''Bellboy'' was in the process of bringing in twelve [[Class-A cargo container]]s when [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] from [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] from [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] arrived to [[Battle of Udnil II|destroy]] the capital ship. The ''Tormentor'' had a complement of [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE Advanced]] fighters to defend the starship. ''Bellboy'' attempted to return to the Star Destroyer's hanger for protection against the Rebels.

==Behind the scenes==
The outcome of the battle depends on what side the player has chosen in the video game [[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter|''X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter'']]. ''Bellboy'' is listed as a bonus objective to be destroyed, should the player choses the Rebellion, or to be defended if the player is Imperial.
